citation: Thomas S. Barthel, Grundlagen zur Entzifferung der Osterinselschrift
contribution: Foundational sign catalogue and corpus nomenclature for Rongorongo texts A-Z.
limits: Historic line drawings and transcriptions require checking against later palaeographic work.
notes: Use as a reference standard, not as final palaeographic truth.

citation: Steven Roger Fischer, Rongorongo: The Easter Island Script
contribution: Major catalogue and interpretation history for inscriptions and previous decipherment attempts.
limits: Contains proposals that require independent testing against corpus structure.

citation: Lorenzo Lastilla et al., Modelling the Rongorongo tablets: A new transcription of the Echancree tablet and the foundation for decipherment attempts
contribution: Provides modern 3D and palaeographic analysis of Text D and stresses accurate transcription as a prerequisite for decipherment.
limits: Focused on Text D, so conclusions should not be generalized to all inscriptions without further checks.

contribution: Public web reference for Barthel-style corpus navigation and transliteration notes.
limits: Must be checked against scholarly publications before promotion to high-confidence claims.
notes: Useful for navigation and source intake, not a substitute for direct scholarly citation.

contribution: Accessible overview of script status, rough corpus size, and undeciphered state.
limits: Secondary summary; do not use for detailed corpus claims.
notes: Useful only for orientation and public-facing explanation.

citation: Silvia Ferrara, Laura Tassoni, Bernd Kromer, Lukas Wacker, Michael Friedrich, Francesca Tonini, Lorenzo Lastilla, Roberta Ravanelli, Sahra Talamo, "The invention of writing on Rapa Nui (Easter Island). New radiocarbon dates on the Rongorongo script"
contribution: Radiocarbon dates for the wood of Tablets A, B, C, and D in Rome; Tablet D (sample P003) gives 474 ± 13 BP.
limits: Dates the wood, not the inscription: the authors treat the result as a terminus post quem and say the inscription may be more recent.

citation: Miguel Valério, Lorenzo Lastilla, Roberta Ravanelli, "The Rongorongo Tablet C: new technologies and conventional approaches to an undeciphered text"
contribution: New drawing and transcription of Tablet C (Mamari) with palaeographic commentary, from the same group as SRC-003.
limits: Not openly licensed: publisher paywall and restricted repository copy. Not accessed by this project; its transcription cannot be imported.
notes: Lingue e linguaggio 2/2022, pp. 333-367. Needed to test the Text C parallels SRC-003 mentions (Cb5, Cb11).
